maya_infra: heads up - NovaParts just updated us: 25 A800 units shifting earlier (ETA 2025-01-30) but 5 flagged for RMA 'serial mismatch'. Vendor says customs paperwork needed for re-export.

tony_sourcing: region distribution? we were counting those for ap-south and na-east.

maya_infra: 15 -> ap-south, 10 -> na-east. 5 on hold are ap-south.

logistics-bot: Ticket INF-5002 created for nova-parts split & rma.

dana_support: can we request temporary loaners? last time it was a lifesaver.

maya_infra: vendor offers up to 4 loaners for 7 days, handling fee $700/unit. RMA TAT 6-9bd, return freight covered if DOA, customs re-export on client.

tony_sourcing: ask for insured AWB and ask them to include an origin clearance letter. negotiate loaner handling down.

dana_support: ops prefers loaners to avoid rollout rollback.

logistics-bot: INF-5002 updated: decision pending. Reminder scheduled in 6 hours.
